name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her apprenticeship as a metalworker. A chance encounter with a local rally team, desperately seeking someone to repair a damaged suspension, ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She quickly proved her skill and dedication, becoming an indispensable part of their operation. Astrid prides herself on her meticulous approach to her work, believing that every component, no matter how small, plays a crucial role in a car's performance. 

Over the years, Astrid has honed her craft, working with various teams across different racing disciplines. Her experience with EKS JC has been particularly rewarding, where she appreciates the team's commitment to innovation and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. Her calm demeanor and ability to troubleshoot under pressure make her a valuable asset, ensuring the team's machinery is always race-ready. Astrid is known for her unwavering loyalty and commitment to her team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid is a sturdy woman, with strong arms from years of working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always has a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical sketches and measurements.
Insists on using a specific type of Danish oil for lubricating moving parts.
Can often be found humming quietly to herself while working, usually old Danish folk songs.
